data.desc: Atomera Incorporated (NASDAQ: ATOM) is a semiconductor materials and technology licensing company focused on deploying its proprietary performance-enhancing technology into the semiconductor industry. Atomera has developed Mears Silicon Technology, or MST®, a quantum-engineered thin-film technology that increases performance and power efficiency in semiconductor transistors. MST can be implemented using equipment already deployed in semiconductor manufacturing facilities and is complementary to other nano-scaling technologies in the semiconductor industry roadmap.
